result.summary: The intersection features wide roadways with multiple travel lanes and a dedicated bike lane. While it includes high-visibility crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and refuge islands, the overall scale and long crossing distances create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be in the path of vehicles for an extended period.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the multi-lane road

hazards.name: Slip Lane
hazards.description: The channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the triangular island

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a green-painted bike lane adjacent to a large institutional building. While pedestrian infrastructure like wide sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing distance across multiple lanes lacks a refuge island or visible signalization.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or visible signal control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is characterized by a very wide multi-lane arterial road with high-visibility crosswalks and signalization. Despite the presence of basic pedestrian infrastructure, the excessive crossing distance and lack of mid-block refuge islands create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least six lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner near the institutional building

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features wide sidewalks, marked zebra crosswalks, and a pedestrian refuge island, providing basic safety infrastructure. However, the large scale of the intersection and multiple travel lanes create a car-centric environment with long exposure times for pedestrians.
